phrases.def: 不带偏见的、不带偏见的、无偏见的、
逐步采取不可避免方式

sentences.en: A ‘Hypotheses,’ said Medawar in 1964, ‘are imaginative and inspirational in character’; they are ‘adventures of the mind’.
sentences.zh: 1964年美达瓦尔(Medawar)说, “性格是富有想象力和灵感的”,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: He was arguing in favour of the position taken by Karl Popper in The Logic of Scientific Discovery (1972, 3rd edition) that the nature of scientific method is hypothetico-deductive and not, as is generally believed, inductive.
sentences.zh: 他主张支持Karl Popper在《科学发现理论》(1972年,第三版)中采取的立场,即科学方法的性质是虚构的诱导,而不是一般认为的感性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B It is essential that you, as an intending researcher, understand the difference between these two interpretations of the research process so that you do not become discouraged or begin to suffer from a feeling of ‘cheating’ or not going about it the right way.
sentences.zh: B 关键是,作为有意研究者,你必须了解研究过程这两种解释之间的区别,以免你感到气馁或开始感到`取舍 ' 或没有正确的方式去研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C The myth of scientific method is that it is inductive: that the formulation of scientific theory starts with the basic, raw evidence of the senses – simple, unbiased, unprejudiced observation.
sentences.zh: C 科学方法的神话是,它具有感官意义:科学理论的形成始于感官的基本原始证据 — — 简单、公正、无偏见的观察。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Out of these sensory data – commonly referred to as ‘facts’ — generalisations will form.
sentences.zh: 这些感官数据通常被称为 " 事实 ",其中的概括性将形成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The myth is that from a disorderly array of factual information an orderly, relevant theory will somehow emerge.
sentences.zh: 传说是,从一系列无序的事实信息中, 将会出现一个有序的、相关的理论。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, the starting point of induction is an impossible one.
sentences.zh: 然而,上岗培训的起点是不可能的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: D There is no such thing as an unbiased observation.
sentences.zh: D 不存在不偏不倚的观察。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Every act of observation we make is a function of what we have seen or otherwise experienced in the past.
sentences.zh: 我们所作的每一项观察行为都是我们过去所看到或经历的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: All scientific work of an experimental or exploratory nature starts with some expectation about the outcome.
sentences.zh: 所有实验或探索性质的科学工作一开始都对结果抱有某种期望。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This expectation is a hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 这种期望是一种假设。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Hypotheses provide the initiative and incentive for the inquiry and influence the method.
sentences.zh: 假设为调查提供了主动性和激励,并对调查方法产生影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is in the light of an expectation that some observations are held to be relevant and some irrelevant, that one methodology is chosen and others discarded, that some experiments are conducted and others are not.
sentences.zh: 鉴于人们期望,一些观察被认为具有相关性,有些与现实无关,选择一种方法,而放弃其他方法,进行一些实验,而其他实验则没有。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Where is, your naive, pure and objective researcher now?
sentences.zh: 你的天真、纯洁和客观的研究员现在在哪里?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: E Hypotheses arise by guesswork, or by inspiration, but having been formulated they can and must be tested rigorously, using the appropriate methodology.
sentences.zh: 假设产生于猜测或灵感,但经过拟订,可以而且必须使用适当方法严格测试。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: If the predictions you make as a result of deducing certain consequences from your hypothesis are not shown to be correct then you discard or modify your hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 如果根据你的假设推断的某些后果而做出的预测被证明不正确, 那么你放弃或修改你的假设。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If the predictions turn out to be correct then your hypothesis has been supported and may be retained until such time as some further test shows it not to be correct.
sentences.zh: 如果预测结果正确,那么你的假设得到支持,并可能保留,直到进一步测试表明其不正确。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Once you have arrived at your hypothesis, which is a product of your imagination, you then proceed to a strictly logical and rigorous process, based upon deductive argument — hence the term ‘hypothetico-deductive’.
sentences.zh: 一旦你得出了你的假设,即你的想象力的产物,然后你根据推论,根据严格的逻辑和严格程序,即`假说——诱导性'一词,开始一个严格、逻辑和严格的过程。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F So don’t worry if you have some idea of what your results will tell you before you even begin to collect data; there are no scientists in existence who really wait until they have all the evidence in front of them before they try to work out what it might possibly mean.
sentences.zh: 也不要担心你是否知道在开始收集数据之前, 分析结果会告诉你什么; 没有任何科学家真正在等待他们掌握所有证据,

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The closest we ever get to this situation is when something happens by accident; but even then the researcher has to formulate a hypothesis to be tested before being sure that, for example, a mould might prove to be a successful antidote to bacterial infection.
sentences.zh: 我们最接近这种情况的是,当某事发生意外时;但即使如此,研究人员也必须先拟订一个假设,然后才能确定,例如,模具可能证明是成功治疗细菌感染的药方。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: G The myth of scientific method is not only that it is inductive (which we have seen is incorrect) but also that the hypothetico-deductive method proceeds in a step-by-step, inevitable fashion.
sentences.zh: G 科学方法的神话不仅在于它具有感性(我们所看到的是不正确的),而且在于,理论的诱惑性方法以逐步、不可避免的方式发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The hypothetico-deductive method describes the logical approach to much research work, but it does not describe the psychological behaviour that brings it about.
sentences.zh: 假设引导方法描述了许多研究工作的逻辑方法,但没有描述由此带来的心理行为。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is much more holistic — involving guesses, reworkings, corrections, blind alleys and above all inspiration, in the deductive as well as the hypothetic component -than is immediately apparent from reading the final thesis or published papers.
sentences.zh: 更全面得多的是,这涉及猜想、改写、矫正、盲巷,最重要的是启发,包括推理和减肥成分,而不是从最后论文或发表的论文中立即看出。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These have been, quite properly, organised into a more serial, logical order so that the worth of the output may be evaluated independently of the behavioural processes by which it was obtained.
sentences.zh: 相当正确地,这些产出已编成一个更连续的逻辑顺序,以便可以独立于获得产出的行为过程来评价产出的价值。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It is the difference, for example between the academic papers with which Crick and Watson demonstrated the structure of the DNA molecule and the fascinating book The Double Helix in which Watson (1968) described how they did it.
sentences.zh: 区别在于,例如,Crick和Watson展示DNA分子结构的学术论文与引人入胜的《双螺旋》一书(1968年),Watson在其中描述了他们的作案方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: From this point of view, ‘scientific method’ may more usefully be thought of as a way of writing up research rather than as a way of carrying it out.
sentences.zh: 从这一观点来看, " 科学方法 " 可能更有用,可以被视为编写研究报告的方式,而不是进行研究的方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
